proof.pattern: change=qhm-ownerstop-1113\] QHM [A-Z.]+ stop set by owner

expected_rate: once on the first QHM cycle after the owner runs scripts/qhm_owner_stop.py set for a held symbol; zero on days with no owner request
window_reason: The code runs only after the owner sets a stop by hand; ten sessions is the longest window the engine allows.
reversal: while an owner stop is applied and before its end date, the broker stop for that hold rests at any price other than the owner's; or a QHM raise step moves it; or the stop is still the owner's price on the session after the end date without a 'your last price kept' page; or any hold is left without a broker stop

metrics.name: broker stop equals owner price while applied
metrics.source: Alpaca open orders for the hold vs data/state/qhm_owner_stops.json
metrics.bound: difference of $0.00 on every cycle between apply and end

metrics.name: QHM holds without a resting stop
